_mapping_note: Spec assumes pgvector/ACL/Whisper stack. EchoMind is FAISS+BM25+SQLite, namespace-based isolation (not per-chunk ACLs), NVIDIA NeMo ASR. Fields below describe the ACTUAL system; spec-only fields are marked not_applicable.

vector_store.permission_predicate: namespace equality test _ns_ok(src) evaluated INSIDE the candidate scan loop in index.py (pre-filter). Not an SQL predicate; not per-chunk ACLs. Sparse BM25 path filtered identically.

chunking.strategy: type-detected: recursive/sentence-aware (flat) — BookRAG parent/child gated off by RAG_ENABLE_BOOKRAG=0

answer_model._note: temperature is the deployed default; experiments override to 0.0

duplex_layer.implementation: voice/app/session.py — L_I lead-phrase loop + L_G grounded RAG loop, phrase-committed TTS

hardware._note: unified CPU+GPU memory (GB10); all services on one node

corpus.domain_mix: DoD FMR regulation PDFs + 5 synthetic vertical demo docs (bank/health/law/meetings/retail) + auto-saved voice transcripts
